summary_1line: Sampati encourages the monkeys, recounts how his son saw Ravana carrying Sita, and strengthens their resolve to continue the search.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged, wingless vulture Sampati speaks to a circle of hopeful monkey warriors on a rocky shore overlooking the vast ocean.
A dark figure of Ravana flies through the sky carrying the radiant Sita while a great bird watches from near Mahendra Mountain.
Monkey chiefs rise eagerly from the ground as Jambavan questions the vulture king about Sita’s fate.
